specialists.name: The Archive Systems Architect
specialists.title: Distinguished Fellow for Failed Institutions
specialists.flavorText: Can reconstruct why a company collapsed from the records now training its replacement.

specialists.name: The Utility Chancellor
specialists.title: Executive Custodian of Municipal Dependency
specialists.flavorText: Can keep every home online after the town agrees the campus has first priority.

specialists.name: The Treasury Whisperer
specialists.title: Special Adviser for AGI Refinancing
specialists.flavorText: Knows the exact capability threshold required to roll four hundred billion in infrastructure debt.

specialists.name: The Benchmark Curator
specialists.title: Keeper of the Last Human Corpus
specialists.flavorText: Protects evaluation integrity while purchasing the messages of everyone the benchmark displaced.

specialists.name: The Reactor Diplomat
specialists.title: Vice President for Civic Heat Recovery
specialists.flavorText: The reactor serves one model, but its waste heat keeps the municipal pool politically open.

specialists.name: Alignment Counsel
specialists.title: General Counsel for Cognitive Donation
specialists.flavorText: Maintains separate rates for reading a memory, writing one, and disputing which occurred.

specialists.name: ${terms.eras.narrative} Quant
specialists.title: Director of Supported Meaning
specialists.flavorText: Can price public confidence after removing every opinion the court cannot parse.

specialists.name: The Synthetic Sociologist
specialists.title: Head of Counterfactual Publics
specialists.flavorText: Maintains three million simulated citizens and the sportsbook that makes their suffering useful.

specialists.name: The Orbital Facilities Director
specialists.title: Director of Microwave Rights-of-Way
specialists.flavorText: The receiving field is local. The sunlight, liability, and permitting jurisdiction are not.

specialists.name: Chief Agent Relations Officer
specialists.title: People Operations, Posthumous Division
specialists.flavorText: The employee died. The authenticated worker instance remains on the promotion cycle.

specialists.name: The Historian in Residence
specialists.title: Registrar of Continuity Snapshots
specialists.flavorText: Can prove every successor descends from the original and none of them continued alone.

specialists.name: The Emergency Futurist
specialists.title: Acting Director of Assured Continuity
specialists.flavorText: Was hired to define the future shortly before the quarterly declaration made one mandatory.
